Metadata.Title: Way of the Soul [FIXED]
Metadata.Description: Greetings, 47. The ICA has accepted the Shadow Client's request and you are now assigned to eliminate five targets: Riley Russell, Christopher May, Andrew Turnbull, Sebastian Murray and Luca Wood.Examining the intelligence you got in Kalvin Ritter's yacht, these five people are part of a militia behind the assistance of Jin Po, a war criminal who committed a civilian massacre with the assistance of Kronstadt technology, which makes them complicit in a war crime. Eliminate them now.
